Nomination and achievement-docket records are not award decisions

What this means for your family

Distinguishing a nomination from an award decision keeps recognition meaningful and traceable.

What this supports

The source materials document preparation or submission for recognition and describe the cited nomination references.

Scope & limits

A nomination, application or achievements dossier is not proof of an award being conferred. Publish an award title only with the issuer’s winner decision or award certificate.

The file named “MSME Award” contains a Udyam registration. It should appear under business registration, not awards.
